title: Mandalorian Flagship
subtitle: Captured from the Empire
text:
While you control a leader unit, this unit gains Ambush. (When you play this unit, it may attack an enemy unit.)
This unit gets +1/+0 for each other friendly Mandalorian unit.
rules: Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. The unit does not have to be ready in order to attack.
